tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The org rail at the far left: the dimmest surface.

tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: Sidebar, board rails, code blocks: one step dimmer than the canvas so the work stands out.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The canvas: page background, inputs, the properties panel.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, run cards, kanban cards, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Drawers, the command palette, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, nav items and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Current nav item, focused row, pressed segment, neutral badges. Never put text-3 on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: borders between regions, card borders, row dividers.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Stronger borders: inputs, buttons, label pills, the drawer edge.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and titles on bg, raised, overlay, hover and selected.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: nav labels, meta, field labels. Reads on every surface.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Faint text: IDs, dates, hints, group counts. On bg, side, raised and overlay only (not on selected).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary buttons, links, focus, selection. Not for status.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fills: agent avatars, info badges, focus halos, pressed label pills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary buttons, the org tile).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid; at least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Teal means exactly one thing: an agent is working on this right now (pulse, Live badge, working strip, live run border).

tokens.name: live-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind live badges and the card working strip; the halo of a live run card.

tokens.name: needs
tokens.usage: Needs you: Review, holds, the Inbox count. Text on bg and raised.

tokens.name: needs-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind needs-you badges and the Inbox count.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Succeeded runs, QA passed, done. Text on bg and raised.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind success badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings in forms, idle agents, budget at 80 %. Text on bg and raised.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning badges and the idle state.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed runs, Stop, destructive actions, errors. Text on bg and raised.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind failure badges; danger button hover.

tokens.name: st-blocked
